text:
maria: Quick proposal: thinking we should standardize span names so dashboards and quota billing can join on them without extra processing. e.g. include route & model in span.name instead of burying everything in attrs. thoughts?

sam: +1 on having model in span.name for query perf. dashboards often group by span name. but prefer attrs for tokens/cache info.

jonah: FWIW routing policy metrics need route id available directly. how about: `span.name = "inference.request/<route_id>/<model_family>"` and keep `redwood.model.version` attr?

irene: We Should avoid putting PII in span.name. route_id is fine, but don't include user or prompt text. Also we need a stable key for rollouts — maybe `redwood.rollout` attr = `canary:42` not in span name.

dan: For quotas/billing we need token counts and cache hits exported as numeric attributes: `redwood.tokens.total`, `redwood.tokens.chargeable`, `redwood.kv.cache_hits`, `redwood.kv.cache_misses`. Those can be aggregated easily.

maria: Example span + attrs sketch I put together:```
span.name: inference.request/route-graphql-1/llama-3
attrs:
  redwood.model.name: "llama-3-70b"
  redwood.model.variant: "q4_0"
  redwood.tokens.total: 128
  redwood.tokens.chargeable: 96
  redwood.kv.cache_hits: 1
  redwood.kv.cache_misses: 0
  redwood.rollout: "canary-2"
  redwood.slo.latency_ms: 45
  redwood.export.keep_prompt: false
```

sam: +1. tiny nit: use snake_case for keys (we already do) and prefer `redwood.model.family` and `redwood.model.revision` split so dashboards can group by family.

jonah: About exporters: we should route billing-relevant spans to metrics backend with lower retention and traces to APM with full retention. OTEL pipeline idea: attributesprocessor to tag `export_target: billing|apm` then use a spanprocessor to route. Example:```yaml
processors:
  attributes/billing:
    actions:
      - key: export_target
        action: insert
        value: billing
exporters:
  billing_metrics: 
    endpoint: https://metrics-internal.redwood
  apm_traces:
    endpoint: https://apm.redwood
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      processors: [attributes/billing]
      exporters: [apm_traces]
    metrics:
      exporters: [billing_metrics]
```

irene: We also need a retention tag so privacy team can request long-term removal. Suggest `redwood.export.sensitivity = low|medium|high` and default to `high` for requests containing any user-provided content unless scrubbed. console can surface it in the request row.

maria: UX/console notes: If span.name carries route+model, the Insights page can automatically show breakdowns by model without an extra attribute transform. For rollouts show `redwood.rollout` as a pill in the timeline and allow clicking to filter.

dan: Query examples we'll run on metrics side: `sum(redwood.tokens.chargeable) by (redwood.model.family, route)` and `sum(redwood.kv.cache_hits) / sum(redwood.kv.cache_hits + redwood.kv.cache_misses) by (route)` — need numeric attrs not strings.

sam: Concern: long model names will make span.name noisy. Limit span.name parts to `route` and `model_family` only. Keep `variant/revision` in attrs.

jonah: Also add `redwood.seq.len_prompt` and `redwood.seq.len_generated` for quality alerts and regression detection. don't forget to mark sampling decisions: `sampling.priority` or `redwood.trace.sample_reason`

ops-bot: deploy: telemetry-otel-collector v2.3 promoted to staging (config branch: telemetry/span-labeling). :rocket:

maria: Next steps: I'll draft RFC with concrete keys, enforcement lint in agent, and an otel-collector example for exporter routing + retention tags. Assigning myself + sam + irene to review. @jonah can you prototype the metrics query panels for billing?

sam: happy to prototype, will mock dashboards and paste links in thread. :eyes:
